protocolDecisions.decision: Keep conditional only; do not add to default because 2D front view cannot honestly distinguish it from tandem well enough.

protocolDecisions.name: Active start timing
protocolDecisions.decision: Start active timing at audible onset of go, using native playback-start/onset instrumentation or a measured per-platform calibration, never a blind hardcoded 604 ms delay.
